install.agents.rule: Golden rule: if the step fits in one sentence with an explicit output format, delegate it; if it needs judgment, architecture or reasoning, do it yourself. Details in the `local-delegation` skill.
install.completion.manifest_unreadable: completion: the manifest {path} cannot be read; going on without it
install.completion.policy_blocks: shell completion: skipping {edition}, because its execution policy is {policy} and it would not load the script; to enable it, run `Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope CurrentUser RemoteSigned` in {edition} and repeat `install --shell-completion`
install.completion.policy_unknown: shell completion: could not check the execution policy of {edition}; writing anyway, and if the profile errors when {edition} starts, run `Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope CurrentUser RemoteSigned`
install.completion.profile_deleted: block removed; install had created the profile and it is left empty, so it is deleted
install.completion.reason.broken_link: it is a broken symbolic link
install.completion.reason.marker_mismatc: it has a local-delegate marker without its pair; fix it by hand
install.completion.reason.nul_bytes: it has NUL bytes without a UTF-16 mark and would be corrupted
install.completion.shell_missing: shell completion: {shell} not found; nothing is written for it
install.completion.uninstall_dir_plan: deletes the completion directory, which is left empty
install.hooks.retire_plan: removes hook scripts from a previous install
install.language.explicit_kept: keeping language {lang}, chosen with `LOCAL_DELEGATE_LANG`; to follow the system again, delete {path} and run `install`
install.language.fallback: the session declares no language: left untouched
install.mcp.keeps_header: — keeps the authorization header it already had
install.mcp.keeps_timeouts: — keeps the timeout it already had ({timeouts})
install.memory.up_to_date: managed block already up to date
install.opencode.has_comments: it has comments and they would be lost
install.opencode.mcp_not_an_object: its '{key}' key is not an object
install.opencode.not_an_object: it does not contain a JSON object
install.opencode.untouched: {path} left untouched: there is no `opencode` CLI and the file cannot be rewritten without destroying what it holds ({reason}). Put opencode on the PATH and try again, or add the '{server}' entry by hand
install.skill.retire_plan: removes skills from a previous version ({names})
install.update.backend_down: ERROR: the backend did not respond again.
install.update.backend_no_port: The backend ({url}) declares no port: the process cannot be located.
install.update.backend_remote: The backend is remote ({host}): there is nothing to restart here.
install.update.backend_untouched: the inference backend was not touched: the models are still in VRAM.
install.update.daemon_down: ERROR: the daemon did not respond again within the waiting time.
install.update.dry_run: --dry-run: nothing was written and no service was restarted.
install.update.editable: EDITABLE install: the code is served from {path}
install.update.editable_hint: Restarting the daemon does NOT change the version. To really update:
install.update.generic_upgrade: update {package} with the package manager you installed it with
install.update.mechanism.fallback: stopping the process and relaunching `serve` detached
install.update.newer_installed: Note: the installed one ({installed}) is NEWER than the one PyPI announces.
install.update.newer_installed_hint: If that is the one you want to pin: local-delegate update --version {installed}
install.update.newer_installed_why: It usually means the release has not propagated yet (or has not finished).
install.update.no_daemon: No daemon to restart: the configuration uses stdio (uvx starts the MCP).
install.update.no_daemon_hint: What applies here is restarting the client (Claude Code / Codex).
install.update.nothing_to_repair: Nothing to repair: the scaffolding is complete and the pins are up to date.
install.update.port_free: Nobody is listening on port {port}; trying to start the backend.
install.update.port_taken: Port {port} is taken by '{name}' (pid {pid}), which is not llama-swap.
install.update.port_taken_hint: Left alone. Check what is listening there.
install.update.pypi_source: PyPI simple index, which is served with a cache
install.update.simulated_home: Simulated HOME: the machine's daemon is left alone.
install.update.simulated_home_note: (simulated --home: that tree is repaired and NO service is touched)
install.update.starting: The daemon does not respond; starting it through {mechanism}…
install.update.still_serving_1: the service stopped but pid {pid} is still serving (detached
install.update.still_serving_2: launcher): the signal goes to the confirmed process.
install.update.uv_tool.cannot_1: `update` cannot update it: it would reinstall the environment it is running
install.update.uv_tool.cannot_2: from, and that breaks the install. Do it yourself, in another terminal:
install.update.uv_tool.installed: The CLI is installed as a `uv tool` at version {installed}.
install.update.version_unknown: Warning: {reason}. Continuing without touching the pins.
